# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.45 (pre-release)

One change asked for by a tester, on top of pre.44 (pre.44 can be skipped). Written and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; the automated tests pass on CI runners. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64, and the new control was not tried in the window.**

**New**
- **Manual tilt per page.** On a cut sheet with a page selected (the page under the mouse, or "Settings for: this page only"), the "Manual tilt" box and its slider are that page's own: the left and the right page can be straightened by different angles. Without a page selected it works on the whole sheet as before. In a project: `page1.page_skew = DEGREES` / `page2.page_skew = DEGREES` (`auto` lets the program measure that page; at most ±45°). Unticking the box returns the page to what the sheet says.

**Read before upgrading**: project files written by this version may carry `pageN.page_skew`; older versions skip such lines and silently lose them.

**Verified**: fmt, clippy `-D warnings`, a core test (only the right page of a cut sheet takes its own angle), a project test (reading, refusing `nan`, `inf`, values beyond ±45° and junk), the existing tests. **Not verified**: the control in the window by hand; Windows, macOS, arm64. On the macOS Intel runner (experimental) two PKCS#12 tests fail because of its OpenSSL, unrelated.
